sentences.text: Preeti Malik vs Ankush Kumar Bhandari on 17 January, 2023

Bench: Surya Kant, J.K. Maheshwari
 M A No
 In The Supreme Court Of India
 Civil Original Jurisdiction
 Miscellaneous Application No. 2031 Of 2022
 In
 Transfer Petition (Civil ) No. 2542 Of 2019

Preeti Malik ... Petiti
 Versus
 Ankush Kumar Bhandari ... Respon
 O R D E R

Learned counsel for the parties jointly state that due to inadvertent mistake, this Court did not quash the criminal proceedings between the parties while passing the order dated 29 th August,
2022, though as per the settlement agreement, the criminal proceedings which are pending between the parties are liable to be quashed.

In this view of the matter, the order dated 29th August, 2022 is modified and a new para 13-A is added on page no. 6 which shall read as follows :-
Consequent upon the settlement agreement dated 2 nd June, 2022 between the parties, FIR No. 494 of 2019 under Sections 498A, 406, 34 IPC registered at Police Station Moti Nagar, Delhi and all the proceedings arising therefrom are hereby Reason: quashed.
